==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Are you making a joke about my height? I don't want to have to teach you some manners!|The Sullustan, to a [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|Tethan Human youngling]] in one adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
